title: shell-init never reads install.prefix, so the machine-install fallback the reference promises is never written into dvb
body:
FOUND 2026-09-23 while 0113's consumer page for shell-init was checked against the code, and driven by cc at 142763d.

lib/config.reference.yaml says of `install.prefix`: "In a consumer the one reader is `shell-init`, which writes it into `dvb` as the machine-install fallback". It never does.

WHY. lib/cmd/shell-init's _shell_init_prefix calls install_prefix_configured, which reads the config cache. The dispatcher's cache does not cross into a handler's process, and shell-init loads no config of its own. So in any project the answer is empty, and only a machine install, which names itself, bakes a location in. Driven in devbin's own checkout, whose config declares `install.prefix: ~/Devel/opt/devbin`: `bin/devbin shell-init zsh` emits `local prefix=${DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX:-}`, with no path in it.

The effect is that a `dvb` generated from a project has no machine-install fallback unless DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX is exported, whatever the project declares. The reference promises otherwise. Either shell-init loads its config, or the reference stops promising it.

## Resolution

Fixed at 4637f94. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. shell-init reads its own project's config, so a declared `install.prefix` reaches `dvb`'s fallback as the reference promised; until now every project answered empty whatever it declared. A config shell-init cannot read still emits `dvb`, without the fallback, and says why on stderr. lib/config's `install.prefix` comment names shell-init as its reader in a consumer. shell-init.md:23 changes with it.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. Both arms are red at the base. P1 (the config never loaded) and P3 (an unreadable config passed over in silence) are killed. P2 (the unreadable branch returns 1) survives as an equivalent mutant: the function runs inside a command substitution that swallows its rc, which the code's own comment says.
- REVIEW. cc: sound. The mode-000 arm skips as root on cc's recommendation.
- THE SUITE. The full suite on the series as it landed -- land018 at c130b3a, whose 27 series paths are byte-identical to the landed commits: 1..1653, 1653 ok, 0 not ok, 4 skips (127, 135, 624, 626), rc 0, 12:39:28Z to 13:11:35Z. Each commit passed the gate (guards, critic, doctor) as it landed.
